title: Wemmbu Warden
description: Changes the warden's model and texture to like Wemmbu from the Unstable SMP
body:
Do you think that the warden vanilla warden is too boring, not enough frightening or just bad? Are you an **Unstable SMP** fan? Than this is the mod you were looking for!

It changes the warden's model and texture to look like **Wemmbu** from the Unstable SMP.

Entity Texture Features [**ETF**] & Entity Model Features [**EMF**] is **required**

The model is heavily inspired by one of _cubicmetre's_ thumbnails. (_Addressing the Unstable SMP Slop Cannon_)

Expect custom sounds and more in the future.
